description: Belgrade environmental-protection staff publish HELP 4.0 water-balance model workbooks for seven unsanitary landfill sites in the metropolitan area. Zenodo provides an archive and text file inventory under CC BY 4.0. Seventeen simulations cover 2005–2022, using a common observed weather series and site-specific profiles, hydraulic-conductivity or runoff sensitivities. The workbooks retain configuration details and daily, monthly and annual simulated outputs, including potential leachate generation. These results can benchmark landfill-drainage, cap-design and receiving-water risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this seven-site release. Coverage is the listed Serbian landfills and model scenarios, not measured daily leachate at every site. A limitation is that proxy radiation and uncertain subsurface properties affect the water balance; one output workbook is not proof of actual leakage. HELP 4.0 is a separate model dependency. No archive or PDF was downloaded, and no mass balance was independently recalculated.
